gem.support.description.coe.unleash: Mana: 150%; Supported Skills deal 50% less Damage when Repeating; Supported Spells gain a Seal every 200% of cast time; Supported Skills have a max of 2 Seals; Supported Skills Repeat 1 time per Seal broken
gem.support.description.coe.upheaval: Mana: 100%; Supported Skills create 1 additional fissures; Supported Skills deal 20% less Damage; Supported Skills have 20% less Skill Speed
gem.support.description.coe.volcanic_fis: Infuses the Skill with Fire Damage.
gem.support.description.coe.vruuns_inevi: Mana: 100%; Supported Skills have 6% increased area of effect per Combo expended; Supported Skills lose Combo if they generate no Combo for 6 seconds; Supported Skills can gain up to 10 Combo Supported Skills expend all Combo on use
gem.support.description.coe.withering_to: Mana: 100%; Supported Skills deal 25% less Damage; Withered lasts 4 seconds; Supported Skills have 1% chance to inflict Withered on Hit for every 0.57142857142857% of enemy Ailment Threshold dealt as Chaos damage; Chance to inflict Withered on Hit with Supported Skills can Surpass 100%
gem.support.description.coe.zarokhs_refr: Mana: 130%; CooldownTime: 5000; Supported Spells Echo 3 times; Echoes from Supported Spells have 40% increased Area of Effect
gem.support.description.coe.zarokhs_revo: Mana: 200%; CooldownTime: 10000; Supported Skills deal 20% less Damage when Repeating; Supported Spells gain a Seal every 50% of cast time; Supported Skills have a max of 5 Seals; Supported Skills Repeat 1 time per Seal broken
gem.support.description.coe.zerphis_infa: Mana: 100%; Supported Skills requires 50 Glory to use; Supported Skills gain Glory equal to 5% of  Life spent on other Skills; Supported Skills have 50% increased Area of Effect; Supported Skills deal 50% more Damage

hold.site.coe.enchanter.description: Uses an Enchanting Table as the marker block to enchant tools/gear with enchanted books, consuming Lapis Lazuli and Ender energy (no vanilla recipe; handled by the enchantment pipeline).
hold.site.coe.ender_charge.description: Endermen and endermites convert Ender energy at the dragon head to replenish the stronghold's energy reserves (occupies no item storage).
hold.site.coe.fish.description: Gathers fish within the designated water area.
hold.site.coe.forestry.description: Fells trees in the designated area, replants saplings and clears leaf litter and vines.
hold.site.coe.hunt.description: Hunts non-player mobs in the designated area; drops go to the bound container.
hold.site.coe.milk.description: Milks the target creatures with a bucket in the designated area.
hold.site.coe.mill.description: Grinds flowers/dye ingredients into the corresponding dye (no vanilla recipe; handled by the conversion pipeline).
hold.site.coe.mining.description: Mines ores in the area using the cartography table as the marker block.
hold.site.coe.recipe.description: Executes all recipes of a given type at the corresponding vanilla workstation, based on a data-driven 'recipe type to block' mapping.
hold.site.coe.shear.description: Shears sheep with shears in the designated area.
